Session start context for Algora bounty issue #834 in UnsafeLabs/Bounty-Hunters.

User request: implement the ProviderModelPicker localStorage persistence fix so the selected AI provider and model are remembered across page reloads.

Issue #834 '[ T3 Code ] Fix ProviderModelPicker not persisting selection across reloads' requires:
- Persist selected provider ID and model ID to localStorage on selection
- Restore selection on component mount
- Fall back to the first available provider when the persisted value is invalid
- Add a 'Reset to default' option that clears the persisted preference
- Share the preference across tabs via the storage event
- Namespace the localStorage key to avoid conflicts
- Keep existing picker behavior unchanged when localStorage is empty

Approach: extract all persistence logic into a pure, testable helper module (providerModelPickerStorage.ts) and wire it into ProviderModelPicker.tsx (restore on mount, write on change, storage-event tab sync, and a 'Reset to default' button). The helper is covered by providerModelPickerStorage.test.ts (16 unit tests).
